newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore 1996 financial sector growth 8.2 pct.
newsitem.headline: Singapore 1996 financial sector growth 8.2 pct.

text.p: Singapore's Trade and Industry Ministry said on Tuesday that the financial and business services sector grew 8.2 percent in 1996, firmer than the 7.6 percent growth of the previous year.
The financial services sub-sector gained from better stock market and foreign exchange market performances but growth in domestic credit expansion moderated, it said, without giving a precise figure.

The business services sub-sector continued to perform strongly. It grew by 9.7 percent in 1996, supported by strong demand for information technology services and robust growth in business hub services, the ministry said.
